headline: Bank of Greece: Inflation to reach 3.5% in 2026 after the September 'jump'
summary: The Bank of Greece forecasts annual inflation of 3.5% in 2026, up from 2.9% in 2025. The acceleration is driven mainly by rising energy prices and sharp increases in services prices.
why: The Bank of Greece is the national central bank and a member of the Eurosystem, and its inflation outlook shapes expectations for euro-area policy and Greek bond yields.
